Card Q&A.q: I didn't activate this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect when my Digimon digivolved into this card.  If this card then attacks during the same turn, can I activate this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon to the hand. Then, by trashing the bottom face-down card under any of your Tamers, return 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon to the hand.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When effects add cards to your opponent's hand or trash cards from under your Tamers, this Digimon may unsuspend.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Gaogamon] in name or w/[DATA SQUAD] trait: Cost 3
